records.name: Glimmergold Association
records.FactionDescription: A traditional shopping street which is struggling amidst the rise of e-commerce and trendy new entertainment districts.
records.ChangeDescription: Attacking Glimmergold members will turn the public against you. Support can be gained through positive actions such as contributing to related factions.

records.name: Azure Sector Citizens
records.FactionDescription: Nestled in the heart of the city, this is a district where everyone’s salary is as high as their blood pressure, where hustlers chase their dreams and layoffs are always lurking around the corner.
records.ChangeDescription: Attacking civilians will turn the public against you. Support can be gained through positive actions such as resolving skirmishes, clearing camps, or contributing to related factions.

records.name: DK9 (Demon Canine)
records.FactionDescription: The underdog is often a champion waiting to be crowned.
records.ChangeDescription: Attacking DK9 members will turn the public against you. Support can be gained through contributing to related factions or becoming a Street Leader.

records.name: Gale Riders
records.FactionDescription: We’re bikers, and we’re unstoppable. We live for the thrill of the wind’s howl.
records.FactionOccupationDescription: 犬魔社占领焱风联合会后描述

records.name: Ronji Hood
records.FactionDescription: In this turf where dreamers run wild, make your move first, and let the rest sort itself out.
records.FactionOccupationDescription: 犬魔社占领龙治团后描述

records.name: G-Krew (GlitchKrew)
records.FactionDescription: We lord over these beats so hard, just call us kings of the underground.
records.FactionOccupationDescription: 犬魔社占领超频帮后描述

records.name: ParaBoar
records.FactionDescription: Watch yourself around those delivery peeps—they’re not messed up in the head, they’re just racing against the clock with those orders.
records.FactionOccupationDescription: 犬魔社占领狂悖野猪后描述

records.name: NCCA (Nova City Crime Agency)
records.FactionDescription: Our duty is to maintain order in Nova City.
records.ChangeDescription: As an NCCA officer, making unauthorized arrests or issuing unfair fines will turn the public against you. Support can be gained through actions such as arresting criminals or penalizing legitimate violations.

records.name: Black Metal
records.FactionDescription: We’ll take out anyone and anything that threatens the boss’s safety.
records.FactionOccupationDescription: 犬魔社占领黑金组后描述

records.name: Masked Malice
records.FactionDescription: Can’t wrap your head around what we’re doing? We like it that way.
records.FactionOccupationDescription: 犬魔社占领谜面帮后描述

records.name: Televised Collective
records.FactionDescription: Taking out televised trash to bring minds together.
